rationale: The double-demeaning is a defensible fix to the archive's rank-product contamination, but the product is symmetric, so the long leg pools cheap-profitable firms with expensive-unprofitable "junk growth" — historically the lowest-returning quadrant — which makes the stated positive expected sign fragile and the claim that HML/RMW loadings "cancel" unverified given the legs are correlated and skewed.

Conditioning an EBITDA yield on cash conversion is an economically coherent, non-RMW-spanned attack on the value-trap channel and is distinct from the archive's stability/trend gates, but oancf/oibdp has a sign-switching denominator (and winsorization does not fix rank inversion for negative oibdp), and pairing an enterprise-level numerator with an equity-only denominator is internally sloppy.

Coverage-adjusted safe-value is a plausible non-FF5 channel, but with (dltt+dlc) in the denominator the second leg degenerates to a low-leverage screen for the many near-zero-debt firms, so the signal risks being B/M × inverse leverage — close to the known leverage decomposition of book-to-market — rather than a genuine debt-service interaction.

Value interacted with a one-year ΔROA is essentially Piotroski-style fundamental-improvement screening of high B/M firms, and relative to the archive's CheapCashYield_x_ImprovingProfitability it changes only the yield proxy and the horizon of the profitability path — a cosmetic variant of an already-tested idea rather than a new mechanism.

This is close to a rediscovery of the published R&D-to-market anomaly and is a near-relabeling of the archive's IntangibleAdjustedValue × profitability signal (numerator merely drops ceq), and COALESCE(xrd,0) piles the majority of firms into a tied zero rank, so the claimed "broad coverage" is illusory and the ranks are driven only by R&D reporters.

A sign-flipped rather than gated value tilt is a genuinely different, well-specified state-dependent design whose HML loading nets out by construction, it avoids the tie-mass problem of hard thresholds, and it forms an informative binary-versus-continuous contrast with the pure-interaction proposal — though it inherits the risk that the long leg's expensive-unprofitable quadrant drags returns down.
